text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Journalists working for state-run newspapers are harrassed by opposition supporters at a news conference called by former president Kenneth Kaunda.
- A Zambian HIV positive doctor who continued working almost nine months after being told that his lover had contracted the HIV virus is sacked in London.
- Government says it will not provide funds for agricultural inputs in the forthcoming season.
- A magistrate orders the arrest of an anti-corruption commission officer for destroying evidence in a case in which four people are charged with drug offences.
- Former president Kenneth Kaunda claims that several government ministers are linked to a drug trafficking and money laundering syndicate.
